Resolves #21742

🌿 The notes can no longer call the planning examples owed while fourteen of them run on `dev`.

Iteration 4 of `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v14.0.0.md` reads the 74 pull requests merged between 2026-11-20T13:51Z and 2026-11-21T05:31Z into the note. The planning chapter gains *Since Friday*: fourteen examples, thirteen of them leaves of the #21346 slate, and the engine changes that building them drove. The home and examples chapters gain the round table, the hero's copy, the cards and the phone header. *Also in 14* gains the window's grid, field, component, build and contributor changes, and *Upgrading from 13.4.0* three behaviour changes, 26 in all. The scale line, the community table and the good-first-issue line are re-counted at 05:31Z, and the first run of a new app joins *What you can try*. Monday's final iteration carries only what needs the cut head: the counts, #20874's reading, the banner and the designations.

Evidence: L2 (the release-note guard specs; each claim read against its pull request's title, body or diff, or a measurement; a headless render of the note's Portal route) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-7). Residual: none.

- #21736 merged at 05:41Z, after the read. The planning chapter's in-review line keeps the 05:31Z state, and the final iteration refreshes it.
